title: Ape Alpha
tagline: Smart data for insightful Apes. Unleashing Governance and Financial Alpha on ApeCoin.
description:
This is a project showcasing Smart data for insightful Apes. 
Unleashing Governance and Financial Alpha on ApeCoin.

Some of the features are:
- Free ApeCoin ecosystem data. Open and made easy.
- Go down to the rabbit hole and profile the ApeCoin token, and staking.
- Discover opportunities and perform due diligence on ApeCoin DAO.

The goal is to help the ApeCoin community the most with:
- A curated list of Pricing and Data market metrics from ApeCoin. ApeCoin Protocol purposes and entities.
- Governance tracking proposals, members and strategies.
- Wallets holding tokens allotted to the ApeCoin DAO treasury and resources with their recent activity .
- A reference summary of the available pools and staking limits.
how_its_made:
This application uses different endpoints from Moralis (API REST), Coingecko (API REST), and Snapshot (GraphQL).

As a blockchain infra provider, the project uses Alchemy.

UseDApp is used for some hooks to interact with the Staking smart contract from ApeCoin.

It was bootstrapped with Vite React App.

Other clients and libraries used are React Query, Apollo Client, React Router v6 and TailwindCSS.

This project is built on ApeCoin.
